001: Haoran, have you confirmed the itinerary for next week's business trip?
Yes, it's confirmed. The flight and hotel have both been booked.
And are the meeting materials all prepared?
The materials are organized, and I also prepared an English version as well.
Great, I'll leave this business trip to you then.
Don't worry, I'll make sure everything is arranged properly.
002: Tianyou, how many days will you be staying in Shanghai for this trip?
About three days. I'll go on Wednesday and come back Friday afternoon.
Do you need me to book a hotel for you?
No need. The company has a partner hotel, so I'll book it myself.
Okay, just remember to keep the receipts so you can get reimbursed.
No problem, I'll save all the receipts.
003: Jingyi, the reimbursement request you submitted after your last trip has been approved.
Really? That's great. I was worried I might have filled something out wrong.
Everything passed the review. The money should arrive within the next couple of days.
That's wonderful. I spent quite a lot on this trip.
You worked hard on the trip. Make sure you get some rest.
Thanks for your concern. I really do need to get a good night's sleep.
004: Junjie, when are you planning to take your annual leave?
I'm planning to take a week off next month. I want to get out and travel a bit.
Do you have a place in mind, or haven't you decided yet?
I want to go to Yunnan. I heard the scenery there is really beautiful.
Yunnan is indeed great. I went last year, and it's definitely worth a visit.
Really? Then do you have any attractions you'd recommend?
005: Yuxuan, how do you feel after coming back from this business trip?
It was a bit tiring, but I gained a lot. I closed deals with two new clients.
That's impressive! Then this trip was definitely worth it.
Yeah, but having meetings for three days straight was really exhausting.
Then make sure you rest well and get yourself back on track.
Yeah, I plan to relax properly this weekend.
006: Zixuan, the company has arranged for you to attend an exhibition in Guangzhou next month.
Okay, what materials do I need to prepare?
Mainly the product brochures and samples. I've already prepared them.
After the exhibition, do I need to come straight back to the office?
No need. You can take two days off while you're there and explore Guangzhou.
That's great. I've actually been wanting to see Guangzhou's night view.
007: Jiaqi, how many days of annual leave do you have left this year?
I still have five days. I'm planning to save them for the end of the year.
The end of the year is the busy season. Are you sure you'll be able to get the time off?
It should be fine. I've already talked to my supervisor about it.
That's good. Planning ahead is always better than asking for leave at the last minute.
Yeah, I'm also thinking of taking my parents on a trip.
008: Tingting, are you taking the high-speed rail or a plane for this trip?
I chose the high-speed rail because the destination is closer to the train station.
How many hours will that take?
A little over four hours. I can take care of some work on the train.
That's pretty good. It's more convenient than waiting around at the airport.
Yeah, and I can use my laptop on the train, so it's more efficient.
009: Haoran, don't forget to write a business trip report after you get back.
Okay, I plan to organize it tomorrow morning.
Make sure to include the client feedback and market information.
Got it. I'll summarize all the key points.
Send it to me when you're done, and I'll help you review it.
010: Jingyi, where are you planning to go for your vacation this time?
I'm planning to go to Chengdu to try the food there.
Chengdu's hotpot and chuanchuan are both very famous. You're going to love them.
Yeah, I've already made a list of all the food I want to try.
Well, have a great time, and bring us back some local specialties.
No problem. I'll definitely bring back something delicious to share with everyone.
